description: Comparable robotaxi operations time series: cumulative distance (km), vehicles, coverage area, and city count, each point sourced. Distance defaults to paid robotaxi km (`distanceKm`); `distanceAllKm` is the broader autonomy series (mixed testing plus Tesla FSD on customer cars). Filter by operator slug or metric name.

metric.description: Optional hint for which series you care about. The full operator record is always returned.

name: get_robotaxi_tracker
